name: module-worker-check-loop
goal: Prove that declared worktree checks feed bounded failures into the same provider session and persist every outcome before review.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: An implementation can use the entire prompt self-check budget and still submit with a failing Phase 4 gate. Assert native verification and resume in the Git-backed worker fixture.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The worker fixture covered claims and review, but never executed a gate between provider turns. Extend the worker lifecycle for repaired and exhausted statuses. Cover provider quota events and completion receipt dispositions in their existing suites.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed failing fixture 21415ecf88fd3bdd31fe4348d298a7f4f337d367 rejects the declared check; the Codex cases drop provider quota facts.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: The committed worker runs up to three checks, sends diagnostics into the original session, and preserves rejected completion evidence.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged Git-backed lifecycle and quota regressions pass in the same test runtime.

steps.title: Run harness loop siblings to record the root cause and evaluate the same pattern across committed source.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
